title: Package icon family
description: One icon per workspace package, all built from the project's spec. scripts/family.js init writes a starter; scripts/family.js build reads it.

base.description: The project's brand spec, relative to this file. Every package inherits its font, palette, skew, & favicon style.

slug.description: The last segment of the package name; the site's page URL & the icon file name.

name.description: Full package name: the SVG title. Defaults to `slug`.

glyph.description: One to three letters on the tile. Defaults to the slug's first letter.

tile.description: A palette name, `@gradient`, or literal colour from the base spec. Defaults to the base favicon tile.

wordmark.description: Also build a wordmark of `text` for this package.

patch.description: Any other spec changes for this package, deep-merged last.
